title: The software nobody plans to build - but every successful team eventually does...
summary: Every software company starts with one product. Given enough time, almost every successful team ends up building a second one they never planned for.

title: What "production-ready" actually means - and why most teams discover it too late.
summary: Production readiness isn't about whether a system runs. It's about how it behaves under failure, change, and scale - and most teams discover the gap too late.

title: The real startup killer isn't product - it's building platform foundations from scratch.
summary: Most early-stage teams think they're building one product. They're actually building two - and the second one quietly consumes man-years of engineering time.
